description: Import a buyer's shopping-preference appraisal (derived by a Mind from the owner's email) onto their VIA Personal Shopper. Requires a link_token the owner minted in their VIA dashboard; it scopes the write to exactly one buyer. Pass ONLY the structured fields (categories, brands liked and avoided, sizes, cadence, budget signal): no free text, individual purchases, addresses, payment methods, order numbers or other personal details, and any extra field is discarded. VIA never receives raw email. Taste signals shape matching immediately and are drafted into the owner's Taste Card for them to approve and publish; the budget signal becomes a PROPOSED spending cap that the owner must approve in the dashboard before it gates any autonomous spend.

appraisal.description: The structured shopping-preference appraisal: taste and budget fields only, no free text or personal details.

link_token.description: The link token the buyer owner minted in their VIA dashboard (POST /api/buyer/[buyerId]/appraisal action=mint_link).

name: import_preference_appraisal
